Weiss–D’Mello Definition24 pp20–21, Lemma7 pp21–22; complete Lemmas12–13 pp41–43 read. Explicit uniform ordered-real-closure construction and full cardinal/cofinality proof independently checked in report.
resolution: For every uncountable cardinal κ (including singularκ), real closures of successively ordered rational-function fields indexed by κ·ω and κ·ω₁ have sizeκ but cofinalitiesω andω₁. Order-preserving RCF embedding followed by relative algebraic closure yields algebraic RCF; Cauchy root bounds work in all ordered fields, and finite variable supports prove the two cofinalities. This is our explicit proof, not a claim that Weiss p38 prints it. All other seven model-count rows had already been fully checked.
